items.title: createTranslationSettingsStep
items.description:
This step creates translation settings based on the provided input.
It supports both single and multiple translation settings creation.
In case of failure, it compensates by deleting the created translation settings.

items.title: createTranslationsStep
items.description: This step creates one or more translations.

items.title: deleteTranslationSettingsStep
items.description:
This step deletes translation settings based on the provided IDs.
It compensates by restoring the deleted translation settings in case of failure.

items.title: deleteTranslationsStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more translations.

items.title: updateTranslationSettingsStep
items.description:
This step updates translation settings based on the provided input.
It supports both single and multiple translation settings updates.
In case of failure, it compensates by restoring the previous translation settings.

items.title: updateTranslationsStep
items.description: This step updates translations matching the specified filters or by ID.

items.title: validateTranslationsStep
items.description: This step validates that the translations are supported by the store.
